zh.title: 二指夹爪设计
zh.summary: 计划自主设计一款二指夹爪，用于人形机器人的抓取与操作任务。目前正在学习并使用 SolidWorks 进行建模，已完成部分简单零件的模型设计，逐步积累机械结构设计经验。

en.title: Designing a two-finger gripper
en.summary: I plan to design a custom two-finger gripper for grasping and manipulation tasks on a humanoid robot. I am learning to model in SolidWorks and have completed models of several simple components, gradually building experience in mechanical design.
